plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Electrical-Engineering-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. TOTAL AS PRINTED: applying the map's own printed credit rule (5 credits unless a parenthetical number is printed) to every printed cell, this plan sums to 185 credits, NOT 180: Years 1-3 sum to 45 each and Year 4 to 50 because each Year 4 quarter prints FOUR rows (Spring's fourth row is blank as printed, so Spring sums to 14: 5 + 5 + capstone (4); Autumn and Winter sum to 18 each). The over-180 total is transcribed as printed and disclosed here, never smoothed. Parenthetical exceptions recorded exactly: B ENGR 494 (3); B EE 495 (3); B EE 496 (4). Unlike the companion Computer Engineering map, this map prints NO parenthetical credit numbers on its combined 'B CHEM 143 + 144: Gen. I Chem & Lab' cell, so that combined entry is recorded at 5 credits under the printed rule, with the combination folded into the lecture entry. The six generic 'B EE Core Course' cells and three 'B EE Upper Division Elective' cells are recorded as choice slots with unique synthetic codes and the printed wording. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the open diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the four-point marker means 'may be fulfilled with Discovery Core'. Printed program requirements: 'Minimum 2.0 GPA in each prerequisite course. All prerequisites completed prior to application quarter'; competitive applicants have prerequisite and cumulative GPAs of 3.4. Printed Year 3 note: 'B EE 215 should be completed in the first quarter of the program. It is required for most upper division EE coursework.' Course titles are transcribed as printed, including the map's hyphen/dash variants ('Calculus with Analytical Geometry I/II/III', 'PHYS 121 - Mechanics', 'PHYS 122 – Electromagnetism', 'PHYS 123 – Waves').
